payload.title: search filter panel lists available categories
payload.errorMessage:
Timed out 10000ms waiting for expect(locator).toHaveCount(5)

Locator: getByTestId('filter-option')
Expected: 5
Received: 0

note: An empty filter panel reads like a broken empty-state or a data bug, but failedRequests shows the filters-config endpoint returning 500 on every attempt — the panel has nothing to render because its data source is down, not because the empty-state logic misfires. A roughly 31% recent failure rate confirms a flapping backend dependency, not a stable UI defect.
